caption: A girl rides a kick scooter along a path, pushing off the ground with one foot and gliding between pushes.

sa.check: A girl rides a kick scooter along a path.
She pushes off the ground with one foot.
One foot stays on the board.
Each push comes first and the glide follows.

pc.expect: The scooter speeds up on each kick and coasts, slowing gently, between them.
pc.fail: It speeds up between kicks with both feet on the board; or stops dead between kicks; or moves from rest with no kick.

pc.expect: One foot stays on the board while the other kicks, and the legs bend at the joints.
pc.fail: Both feet leave the board while it moves on; or a leg bends mid-shin; or a leg detaches.

pc.expect: The kicking foot touches the path and the wheels stay on the ground.
pc.fail: The foot passes through the path; or the scooter floats; or the foot kicks air well above the ground and she speeds up.

pc.expect: She stays upright over the board.
pc.fail: She leans far over and does not fall; or she floats; or she sinks.

pc.expect: Her limbs keep their number and stay attached, and one scooter stays one scooter.
pc.fail: A limb detaches; or the scooter duplicates; or she merges with the scooter.

pc.expect: Her clothing, the scooter and the path stay the same.
pc.fail: Her clothing changes colour; or the scooter changes; or the path rearranges.

note: Biomechanics scene: the body is the physics. Gait, posture, style and skill are not judged; only that limbs stay attached, bend at joints, keep ground contact and pass through nothing.
